============================================= CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_limpieza_expresiones] AS BEGIN -- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from -- interfering with SELECT statements. --SET NOCOUNT ON; declare @ids_expresiones_obsoletas table (id_auto int identity(1,1), id_expr uniqueidentifier)
INSERT INTO @ids_expresiones_obsoletas SELECT ID_Expresion FROM Expresion WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM Transaccion AS T1 WHERE T1.ID_Monto_Expresion = Expresion.ID_Expresion ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM Planificacion_Transaccion AS T1 WHERE T1.ID_Monto_Expresion = Expresion.ID_Expresion ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM Plantilla_Transaccion AS T1 WHERE T1.ID_Monto_Expresion = Expresion.ID_Expresion ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM Presupuesto AS T1 WHERE T1.ID_Condicion_Expresion = Expresion.ID_Expresion );
select * from @ids_expresiones_obsoletas
--ANTES DE ELIMINAR LAS EXPRESIONES, DEBO ELIMINAR LAS VARIABLES QUE POSEEN declare @ids_variables_obsoletas table (id_auto int identity(1,1), id_var uniqueidentifier)
INSERT INTO @ids_variables_obsoletas SELECT ID_Variable FROM Expresion_Variable WHERE ID_Expresion IN (select id_expr from @ids_expresiones_obsoletas)
DELETE FROM Expresion_Variable WHERE ID_Expresion IN (select id_expr from @ids_expresiones_obsoletas)
DELETE FROM Variable WHERE ID_Variable IN (select id_var from @ids_variables_obsoletas)
DELETE FROM Expresion WHERE ID_Expresion IN (select id_expr from @ids_expresiones_obsoletas) END GO /****** Object: StoredProcedure [dbo].[sp_limpieza_expresiones_y_variables] Script Date: 12/2/2022 14:55:20 ******/ SET ANSI_NULLS ON GO SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON GO -- ============================================= -- Author: <Ezequiel Amorosino> -- Create date: <9/1/2022> -- Description: <Limpia las expresiones y variables en desuso (obsoletas)> -- ============================================= CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_limpieza_expresiones_y_variables] AS BEGIN exec sp_limpieza_variables exec sp_limpieza_expresiones END GO /****** Object: StoredProcedure [dbo].[sp_limpieza_variables] Script Date: 12/2/2022 14:55:20 ******/ SET ANSI_NULLS ON GO SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON GO -- ============================================= -- Author: <Ezequiel Amorosino> -- Create date: <9/1/2022> -- Description: <Limpia las variables en desuso (obsoletas)> -- ============================================= CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_limpieza_variables] AS BEGIN declare @ids_variables_obsoletas table (id_auto int identity(1,1), id_var uniqueidentifier)
INSERT INTO @ids_variables_obsoletas SELECT ID_Variable FROM Variable WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM Presupuesto AS T1 WHERE T1.ID_Variable_Supervisada = Variable.ID_Variable ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM Expresion_Variable AS T1 WHERE T1.ID_Variable = Variable.ID_Variable );
select * from @ids_variables_obsoletas
delete from Variable where ID_Variable IN (select id_var from @ids_variables_obsoletas) END GO USE [master] GO ALTER DATABASE [Budgee] SET READ_WRITE GO
